title: Health
description:
How startup of the running system ended (`recab health --json`): the
verdict a trial judges by.

failed.description:
The units or services that failed (and, on OpenRC, crashed daemons),
sorted, by bare name; listed even when startup did not finish.

finished.description:
Startup ran to its end, healthy or not (`startup` is `running` or
`failed`).

state.description:
The init's own word: systemd's `is-system-running` answer, OpenRC's
softlevel, or `timed out`.

Startup.description: How system startup ended, as the init adapter reports it.

oneOf.description: Startup ran to its end with nothing failed.
Startup ran to its end with something failed.
Startup ended in the init's emergency state.
Still starting when the deadline passed.
No verdict (shutting down, the init unreachable).
